title: Director, Brand Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">LTK’s mission is to empower the world’s premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we’re looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth.</span></p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Director, Brand Partnerships (UK)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> London, UK<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> VP, Brand Partnerships (EU)<br><strong>Role Type:</strong> Full Time</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a <strong>Director, Brand Partnerships</strong> to join our growing EU Brand Partnerships team.</p> <p>This is a senior commercial role responsible for driving enterprise growth across the UK through the acquisition, growth and strategic development of LTK's most valuable brand partnerships. You'll own the development of high-value relationships with leading fashion, beauty, lifestyle and luxury brands, positioning LTK as a trusted, long-term creator commerce partner.</p> <p>As one of the UK's most senior commercial leaders, you'll lead consultative sales conversations with executive stakeholders, identifying opportunities to solve complex marketing challenges through LTK's full-funnel creator marketing solutions. You'll be responsible for building new enterprise relationships while strategically growing a portfolio of LTK Europe’s highest-potential and highest-value brand partners. Through a consultative approach, you'll develop a healthy pipeline of opportunities, convert new business and expand long-term investment across your accounts.</p> <p>Working closely with Brand Activation, Creator Success, Campaign Operations and Marketing, you'll own the long-term growth of strategic brand partners, taking over once brands have successfully onboarded and transitioned through their initial activation phase to maximise retention, investment and lifetime value.</p> <p>This role is ideal for an experienced enterprise seller who thrives on opening new opportunities, influencing senior decision-makers and building meaningful commercial partnerships across every level of a brand's marketing organisation—from executive leadership through to day-to-day marketing teams.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Own</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Enterprise Sales & Market Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Develop and execute the UK enterprise & mid market business strategy across fashion, beauty, lifestyle and luxury sectors.</li> <li>Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of high-value opportunities through strategic prospecting, networking and industry engagement.</li> <li>Develop relationships across senior marketing organisations, including CMOs, Marketing Directors, Digital, Social, Affiliate and Ecommerce leaders.</li> <li>Lead complex consultative sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and contract execution.</li> <li>Position LTK as a strategic creator commerce partner by delivering insight-led, value-based sales conversations.</li> <li>Consistently exceed ambitious Managed Services and Advertising revenue targets.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Strategic Account Growth</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic brand partners, identifying opportunities to increase investment across LTK's commercial solutions.</li> <li>Develop long-term account strategies that deepen relationships and expand LTK's footprint across multiple business units.</li> <li>Identify opportunities across creator collaborations, paid media, content, licensing, events and emerging commercial products.</li> <li>Build trusted executive relationships that position LTK as a long-term strategic marketing partner.</li> <li>Deliver executive business reviews, strategic recommendations and commercial proposals that support long-term partnership growth.</li> <li>Partner with clients to solve evolving marketing challenges through innovative creator-led solutions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Commercial Leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Brand Activation to ensure a seamless transition of newly activated brands into long-term commercial management.</li> <li>Collaborate with Marketing, Creator Success, Campaign Operations, Product and Operations to deliver an exceptional partner experience.</li> <li>Share market intelligence and customer feedback to influence product development, commercial strategy and go-to-market initiatives.</li> <li>Lead the development of sales playbooks, enterprise outreach strategies and consultative selling best practices.</li> <li>Identify emerging categories, market trends and whitespace opportunities to expand LTK's enterprise footprint across the UK.</li> <li>Represent LTK across the UK marketing industry by building executive-level relationships, speaking at key industry events and strengthening LTK's position as the leading creator commerce platform.</li> <li>Act as a senior commercial leader within the UK Brand Partnerships team, shaping commercial strategy, coach consultative selling and foster a culture of high performance</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Sales Excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Consistently exceed individual sales quotas while contributing to wider UK Business Partnerships objectives.</li> <li>Use performance data and commercial insights to continuously optimise sales strategy and pipeline health.</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting and reporting through HubSpot and internal systems.</li> <li>Build compelling, insight-led presentations and business cases tailored to executive audiences.</li> <li>Stay ahead of consumer trends, retail innovation and the evolving creator economy to identify new commercial opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years' experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships or business development within digital marketing, media, SaaS or influencer marketing.</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently exceeding commercial targets through enterprise new business acquisition and strategic account growth.</li> <li>A consultative relationship builder who earns trust quickly and is comfortable influencing senior stakeholders through insight rather than transactional selling.</li> <li>Experience leading complex consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and executive decision-makers.</li> <li>Exceptional commercial acumen with the ability to translate market trends into compelling business opportunities.</li> <li>Outstanding presentation, negotiation and executive communication skills.</li> <li>Strong understanding of influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, social commerce and the evolving creator economy.</li> <li>Comfortable influencing cross-functional teams and execution focused.</li> <li>Proactive, entrepreneurial and driven to build new commercial opportunities.</li> <li>Fluent English language skills; additional European languages are a plus.</li> <li>A title: Senior Risk Engineer
description: <p><strong>We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.</strong></p> <p><span data-teams="true">Capstone is a global, alternative investment management firm operating across a broad range of derivatives-based strategies with a deep understanding of volatility. With approximately $14.6 billion of AUM and 315 employees (as of September 1, 2026, Capstone was formed in 2007 and is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Tokyo, California, Stamford, Boston, and Milan. </span></p> <p><span data-teams="true">At Capstone, we constantly aim to expand our view of how WE SEE THE WORLD DIFFERENTLY® in order to create opportunity. Our commitment to provoking the evolution of asset management provides us with a perpetual hunger for knowledge that we believe drives the improvement of our particular approach to investment. We seek to harness the complexities of global derivatives markets with disciplined strategic insight, an experienced, accomplished team and advanced technology to create sustainable value. We’ve created a particular approach to investment that we believe drives continuous improvement and opportunities for our clients, team and industry.</span></p> <p><strong>The Team:</strong></p> <p>Capstone is looking to appoint a Senior Risk Engineer at Senior Vice President level within Risk Technology. This is a hands-on role combining software engineering, risk and financial markets, with direct exposure to the investment process. You will design and build investment-facing risk and decision-support capabilities, remaining close to the code, data and users from initial problem through to production.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to build the technology behind Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy - turning complex risk and portfolio data into timely, actionable intelligence. You will develop tools that help Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider across stress scenarios, risk factors, margin, liquidity and portfolio analytics. The work will directly support sizing, trade expression, hedging, portfolio construction and capital allocation - helping drive better decisions, more efficient capital and more repeatable alpha.</p> <p>You will work closely with Risk Managers, Portfolio Managers, Quant Research and the wider Technology, Data and AI teams. The role requires deep technical contribution, end-to-end ownership and the ability to shape outcomes through strong judgement, delivery and collaboration. It offers broad exposure across strategies and asset classes, together with the opportunity to help shape the next generation of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform.</p> <p>We are building a high-performing team that values ownership, collaboration and solving difficult problems. We encourage curiosity and new ideas, alongside the discipline and reliability needed to deliver and support critical production systems.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect, build and own production-grade components of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform, remaining close to the code, data and users and designing for performance, scalability, reliability and usability.</li> <li>Build and evolve scalable cross-asset risk capabilities spanning Greeks and sensitivities, stress scenarios, VaR, P&L vectors and attribution, limits, factor analytics, margin, and exposure aggregation.</li> <li>Partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Quant Research to solve complex derivatives, risk and portfolio challenges, taking ideas from problem definition through to production.</li> <li>Build APIs, data pipelines and interactive decision tools that help users understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider at trade, POD, strategy and fund level.</li> <li>Translate pricing and risk methodologies into scalable, explainable services, with clear treatment of model assumptions, calibration, validation and controls.</li> <li>Advance Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy by building tools that turn research, risk analytics and AI into practical investment insight - helping Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers analyse scenarios, understand book and factor exposures, diagnose P&L and access validated analytics through natural language.</li> <li>Engineer and operate resilient risk services, integrating positions, market and reference data, and internal or third-party analytics, with strong testing, data lineage and end-to-end ownership of production issues.</li> <li>Shape and deliver high-value components of the Risk Technology roadmap in partnership with Technology, Data and AI teams, using common platforms, standards and engineering practices and contributing to design reviews, code reviews and knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our future colleague has these skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, quantitative development or risk technology within a hedge fund, asset manager, investment bank or comparable capital-markets environment, with meaningful exposure to front-office or market-risk systems.</li> <li>A strong record of personally designing, building and supporting production-grade risk, pricing or trading systems, and owning complex projects from definition through delivery and support.</li> <li>Advanced Python / Java and SQL skills, together with strong proficiency in at least one comparable language; practical experience with APIs, distributed or event-driven architectures, databases, data pipelines and large-scale processing.</li> <li>Strong understanding of derivatives and cross-asset risk analytics, including option pricing, Greeks, scenario analysis and VaR. Knowledge of factor risk and margin analytics is desirable.</li> <li>Strong architecture and engineering judgement, with a focus on maintainability, testability, performance, controls and operational resilience.</li> <li>Ability to critically assess model outputs, challenge assumptions and trace discrepancies across data, calibration, methodology and implementation, while explaining conclusions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience integrating internally developed and third-party pricing and risk libraries across asset classes, with strong attention to data lineage, reconciliation, consistency and controls.</li> <li>Clear, concise communication and evidence of technical leadership through judgement, ownership, and delivery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers, Quant Research and engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p class="x_x_x_x_MsoNormal"><strong><span lang="EN-GB" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Bonus skills:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience applying machine learning, large language models agentic tools or AI-assisted development in a controlled production environment, including evaluation, access controls, monitoring and human oversight.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating modern engineering and data platforms, including cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, streaming, data lineage and observability.</li> <li>Deep product and risk knowledge in at least one asset class, combined with a broad working understanding across multiple asset classes, including equities, fixed income, credit, commodities and FX.</li> </ul> <p><span lang="EN-GB"><strong>Benefits & Compensation Information:</strong></span></p> <p>Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this.  We offer a robust and competitive benefits program to ensure the well-being of our colleagues.</p> <p>Some benefits included in this role are:</p> <ul> <li>Training and development opportunities</li> <li>Robust Wellness Resources: Physical, Mental and Financial</li> <li>Time-Off, Retirement and Commuter Benefits</li> <li>Gym Reimbursement and other Discounts</li> </ul> <p>The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.</p> <p>In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.</p> <p>To learn even more about being part of the team, visit us online: <a href="https://www.capstoneco.com/careers/">Careers - Capstone (capstoneco.com)</a></p> <p>Don’t forget to follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/capstone-investment-advisors/">LinkedIn</a></p> <p><strong>Capstone’s Commitment</strong></p> <p>At Capstone, we value a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel appreciated and respected. Our commitment to a nondiscriminatory approach extends equal opportunities for employment and advancement across our programs, departments, and locations. We actively seek and appreciate a variety of life experiences and heritages and advocate for the amplification of all voices.</p> <p>At Capstone, we're all about creating a workplace where you can thrive and make a real impact. We value innovation, teamwork, trust, and discipline, and we know you do too.</p> <p><strong>Experimentation:</strong> We love fresh ideas and encourage you to try new things. Here, you’ll have the freedom to innovate and help shape our strategies.</p> <p><strong>Collaboration:</strong> We’re big on teamwork. You'll join a supportive community where everyone’s input matters, and we learn from each other every day.</p> <p><strong>Trust:</strong> We believe in building strong, honest relationships. You'll be part of an environment where your contributions are respected and integrity is key.</p> <p><strong>Discipline:</strong> In our fast-paced world, staying focused is crucial. We commit to high standards and a disciplined approach, helping you grow both personally and professionally.</p> <p>Be part of a team that values your creativity and dedication. Together, let's push boundaries and achieve great things.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer</strong><strong><br></strong>Capstone is committed to creating an inclusive environment where we welcome people of different backgrounds. Capstone considers applications for employment without regard to all applicable protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, parental status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Remote UK
description: <p>Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.</p> <p>So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.</p> <p>Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll be the tip of the spear for Square's most strategic, high-value deals. apply AI tools to sharpen your research, automate workflows, and increase your overall output</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a track record of closing complex, high-value deals with end-to-end ownership</li> <li>Deep experience in technical sales cycles — you're fluent in conversations involving API integrations, custom development, and platform configuration, and you collaborate naturally with Solutions Engineering teams</li> <li>A proven ability to orchestrate multi-stakeholder deals — internally and externally — with exceptional communication, follow-through, and organizational discipline</li> <li>Executive presence that's equally at home on a conference stage, in a C-suite boardroom, or on a discovery call with a technical champion</li> <li>Experience selling a complex ecosystem of SaaS or fintech products, ideally in payments, commerce, or adjacent verticals</li> <li>The ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — you don't wait to be told what to do next</li> <li>A talent for translating complexity into clarity — whether that's simplifying a technical integration for a CFO or structuring an ambiguous problem for an internal stakeholder</li> <li>A BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel ~40%</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role</h2> <p>Square is growing our upmarket sales motion. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly". Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently. Nice to Have: Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases. Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers). Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy. About Sitemate: Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world. Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records. With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture. Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site. We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada. Life at Sitemate At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day. We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure. We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. Our Core Values Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate. Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change High Vis : A high visibility, transparent and open environment Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself Learn more about our values: Read: On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA Listen: Unleashing your Zilla On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture What We Offer Competitive, performance-based remuneration Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build 25 days paid annual leave , plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support) Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources Laptop and home office setup budget Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube Equal Opportunity We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer. We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards. Depending on your expertise, your work could include: Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise. Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk. Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail. Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community. You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and experimental teams across the company. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed. You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work. You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim. You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them. You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. You care about enabling useful scientific and medical applications of AI and are motivated to make them safer. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Lead and develop a high-performing team - Manage and grow a cross-functional team of marketers spanning digital, demand generation, content strategy, and campaign execution. Foster a culture of craft, speed, and accountability. - Own the EMEA content and campaign narrative - Develop messaging houses grounded in real customer problems, use cases, and outcomes. Build modular, deployable content bills of materials (BOMs) — stories, assets, templates, talk tracks, proof points, and examples — that travel across channels and markets. - Lead regional demand generation - Leadership over the EMEA demand engine—across self serve and sales assist audiences, with repeatable programmes that have clear positioning, modular assets, and measurement plans that connect directly to pipeline and revenue. - Orchestrate market launches and flagship campaigns - Translate global narratives into market-ready messaging, toolkits, and channel plans. Lead the content and toolkit workstream for product launches and flagship regional campaigns. Keep cross-functional plans, assets, and timelines aligned and deployable across EMEA. - Enable the wider regional team - Partner with Country Marketing, Storytelling, Sales, and global Product Marketing to ensure consistent storytelling, proof points, and talk tracks across every market and channel. Your team's output is what others build from. - Scale with AI - Build and apply AI-driven workflows to accelerate research, drafting, localisation, and asset iteration at speed — without sacrificing accuracy or customer relevance. Model this capability for the broader team. - Measure and sharpen - Use funnel insights — engagement data, customer feedback, and business metrics — to continuously refine messaging, content, and programmes. Report on what's working and make the case for change when it isn't. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years in B2B marketing — with meaningful time owning both content/narrative and demand generation in a high-growth or enterprise SaaS environment. - Proven people leadership — experience building, managing, and developing multi-disciplinary marketing teams. You know how to hire for craft and lead through ambiguity. - Narrative and content mastery — you can write a compelling messaging house, build a scalable toolkit, and coach others to do the same. Customer empathy is instinctive, not a checklist item. - Demand generation depth — hands-on experience running and optimising paid, email, webinar, and outbound programmes, with a strong grasp of funnel metrics and revenue attribution. - AI fluency — you actively use AI tools to accelerate your work and can design workflows for your team to do the same. Not a curiosity — an active working practice. - EMEA market knowledge — experience running multi-market programmes across EMEA with an understanding of localisation needs, cultural nuance, and go-to-market variation across the region. - Cross-functional influence — able to align and work effectively across global and regional stakeholders in Sales, Product Marketing, Comms, and Country teams — without always having formal authority. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is £132,000-£155,000per year. data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">influence</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Argos</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">, ,</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Maxx</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> and Pernod Ricard. </span></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="scxw40112971" data-ccp-charstyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"c8606303-8a6a-57a4-9e75-879ecb129bcc|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Aptos",469777842,"",469777843,"Aptos",469777844,"Aptos",201341986,"1",469769226,"Aptos",268442635,"24",469775450,"scxw40112971",201340122,"1",134233614,"true",469778129,"scxw40112971",335572020,"1",469778324,"Default Paragraph Font"]}"> </span></span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"><br></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">In 2023, Ogilvy UK celebrated their 75th anniversary and was the most awarded agency in Europe. Ogilvy is home to the largest influencer marketing practice </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">globally, and</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">Nudgestock</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun"> – now in its 12th year. </span></span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="scxw40112971"> </span></span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="normaltextrun">The Role:</span></span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="eop"> </span></span> <br> <br><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"aaed607e-c2a3-5841-9fb4-41037bfa0faf|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",201342449,"1",469777841,"Times New Roman",469777842,"Times New Roman",469777843,"Times New Roman",469777844,"Times New Roman",201341986,"1",469769226,"Times New Roman",268442635,"24",469775450,"paragraph",201340122,"2",134233614,"true",469778129,"paragraph",335572020,"1",335559740,"240",201341983,"0",134233118,"true",134233117,"true",469778324,"Normal"]}">As an Influence Account Director at our company, you will play a crucial role in leading some of the most exciting and challenging projects in the industry. You will be armed with your experience and proven ability to think and do, enabling you to tackle complex problems with ease. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At our company, we pride ourselves on delivering strategic and impactful influence campaigns that align with our clients' objectives. As the Influence Account Director, you will bring a solid understanding of influence strategy, always ensuring that you and the team are working towards strategic objectives. Your experience managing large multi-market campaigns will be invaluable in delivering campaigns that make a real difference to our clients. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In addition to your day-to-day responsibilities, you will provide senior counsel to clients, advising on industry developments as they occur and showing relevance for clients on the ground. You will stay up-to-date with cultural/social trends and customers’ views and attitudes. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We are PMG</strong></p> <p>PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.</p> <p>If you’re passionate about shaping mark.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.</li> <li>Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.</li> <li>Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, developing creator-led programs that connect cultural insight, platform behavior, audience needs, and client business goals.</li> <li>You have strong experience in contract review and proposal development, navigating creator and partnership negotiations with clarity, consistency, and a focus on delivering value for clients and partners.</li> Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn. Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow. System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you. Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change. Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work. Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. Migration Solution Architecture: Designing end-to-end migration solutions covering data extraction, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation and exception management, ensuring alignment with Kaluza architecture and engineering standards. Data Extraction Strategy: Consulting with and supporting clients in designing and developing robust extraction capabilities, including defining extract specifications, formats, sequencing, dependencies and data quality expectations. Migration Tooling & Engineering Collaboration: Working closely with Engineering teams to define requirements for migration tooling, APIs, ETL processes, validation frameworks and automation required to execute migrations safely and efficiently. API, Integration & ETL Expertise: Applying a strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines and large-scale data processing to design scalable migration approaches. Data Quality & Validation: Defining validation rules and data quality controls across extraction, transformation and loading, identifying data issues early and agreeing remediation approaches with clients and engineering teams. Migration Reconciliation: Designing reconciliation frameworks to demonstrate completeness and accuracy of migrated data, including source-to-target reconciliation, control totals, exception reporting and business validation. Client Solution Design: Architecting and presenting client-specific Kaluza migration solutions, clearly explaining technical design decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and the business outcomes the proposed approach will deliver. Migration Strategy & Planning: Developing client-specific migration strategies and plans, including migration cohorts, sequencing, volumes, frequency, throughput, eligibility criteria and migration windows. Migration Performance & Scalability: Assessing data volumes, processing capacity and system constraints to ensure migration solutions can achieve required throughput and scale while protecting platform stability. Migration Testing Strategy: Defining the technical migration testing approach across component testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, migration dry runs, trial migrations and production readiness. Cutover & Production Migration Architecture: Designing the technical approach for migration cutover, including sequencing, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, rollback or recovery approaches, monitoring and operational readiness. Technical Migration Leadership: Acting as the technical authority for migration throughout implementation and live execution, providing technical direction, resolving complex issues and coordinating decisions across client, Engineering, Product and programme teams. Technical Governance & Design Assurance: Representing migration within programme and architecture governance, reviewing technical designs, managing architectural risks and dependencies, and ensuring migration solutions remain aligned with agreed standards. Issue & Root Cause Analysis: Leading investigation of complex migration failures and data issues, distinguishing between source-data, transformation, integration, platform and migration-tooling problems and driving appropriate resolution. Requirements & Technical Analysis: Translating business and migration requirements into clear technical requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria, while challenging assumptions and identifying gaps, dependencies and constraints. Migration Optimisation: Using evidence from testing, dry runs and live migrations to fine-tune migration rules, tooling, performance, sequencing and operational processes. Commercial & Pre-Sales Support: Leading the migration architecture elements of commercial proposals, including solution definition, technical feasibility, assumptions, dependencies, complexity assessment and estimation. Deployment & Implementation Architecture: Leading migration architecture within the broader client deployment and implementation design, ensuring migration is integrated effectively with platform configuration, integrations, testing and operational readiness. Technical Documentation & Migration Playbooks: Producing high-quality architecture documentation, technical specifications, data mapping artefacts and client-specific migration designs, while developing reusable Kaluza standards, patterns and playbooks to accelerate and standardise future migrations. You are comfortable working with large, diverse datasets and possess a strong understanding of how enterprise systems function. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote. You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity. We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here. This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job. Responsibilities Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation Requirements You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value You've worked in a scaleup where process was still being built You use AI tools daily in your CS work and can point to specific workflows You can disagree with a senior customer and keep the relationship intact It’d be a bonus if you could bring Hands-on experience with Planhat, Salesforce, or similar CS platforms Track record of identifying and converting commercial expansion opportunities (seat upsells, module flags) Benefits Salary: £55,000 - title: Controls Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Robotics Team The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle) Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them) Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards 🧩 What you’ll be working on: In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology. 🙌 You should apply if you have: Required Skills/Experience Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles) Experience with test and validation discipline : unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics. Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++ Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware Desired Skills/Experience Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262) Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen : general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context. Competency Interviews : programming and code review. Deep-dive technical interviews : domain knowledge & system design. Final interview : mission & values alignment. We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. About the role At Artificial, there are three primary sources of documentation we maintain: Client-facing product documentation for insurance business users (brokers, underwriters and operations teams using our platform) Our internal documentation site, which is our most heavily used documentation surface, built docs-as-code from the engineering repository and authored largely by engineers. Our public API documentation, owned and authored by our Integrations team from auto-generated OpenAPI specifications. The below responsibilities break down how each of these three sources are to be managed. proactively identify potential gaps and triage incoming gap reports route each one to the best-placed author and chase it to completion write the content yourself where you're the right author Steward the publishing pipelines healthy Interview engineers about new features as they ship, and demystify them for non-technical readers before anyone has to ask Act as editorial reviewer on documentation changes, catching duplication, misplacement and unclear writing before it ships Write and maintain the highest-value client-facing content yourself: core product guides and release communications Select, build and run the documentation toolchain, including docs-as-code workflows (static site generators, CI/CD, review gates) where they serve us best Design and operate AI-assisted authoring pipelines that raise quality and throughput without sacrificing accuracy Build the contribution model: templates, style standards and review processes that let product managers and engineers contribute content you curate rather than gatekeep Partner with the Integrations team on API documentation: raise the quality of guides and examples around the auto-generated reference without taking authorship away from the experts Partner with product and customer-facing teams so documentation ships with releases, not after them Measure whether documentation is working: usage, search behaviour, support deflection and client feedback, and act on what you find Set the standard for clear technical communication across the company About you 6+ years in technical writing, documentation engineering or a closely related discipline Preferably an ex Engineer who has stepped into technical writing / documentation Demonstrable experience producing end-user product documentation, plus enough developer documentation experience to edit and improve API guides credibly Hands-on experience owning documentation tooling, including docs-as-code workflows (for example Git-based authoring, static site generators, CI pipelines) A portfolio or writing samples that show you can make complex technical material clear for both technical and non-technical readers Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed Confident in reading and understanding code and pull requests, so that you are able to identify where documentation might need adding/editing We especially want to hear from you if you have: Built or substantially restructured a documentation estate, not just contributed to one Experience establishing contribution models where engineers and product managers write and you edit and curate Practical experience using LLMs in documentation workflows, with a clear-eyed view of where they help and where they fail Familiarity with structured documentation frameworks such as Diataxis Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications and generating reference documentation from source Previously worked in a scale-up environment Come from an InsurTech, FinTech or other regulated-industry background Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance Life insurance of 4 * Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins. On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions. On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers. Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most. The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.” Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution. This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly. Responsibilities You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means: Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch. Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join. Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed. Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into: the user behaviour driving the request two or three platform-valid approaches a recommendation, with trade-offs explained Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts. Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem. Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure. Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread. Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations. About you You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery. You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where: the design system already exists the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary. You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow. Insurance or Lloyd’s experience is a plus, but is not a requirement. We care more about how you think about complex platforms and stakeholders than about prior domain knowledge, which you can learn here. We especially want to hear from you if you have Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality. Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries. Strong problem-solving skills. Experience in a distributed work environment. to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation.</li> <li>Guiding customers through Monzo’s business banking offerings - providing clear, factual information and helping them evaluate what works best.</li> <li>Being a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services.</li> <li>Managing a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking.</li> <li>Driving activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up, onboarded, and are using Monzo for their banking needs.</li> <li>Collaborating internally: work closely with marketing, product, risk and customer operations to ensure a smooth journey for customers.</li> <li>Delivering outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieving sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.</li> <li>Feeding insights back: capture and share customer feedback — customer pain points, required features, suggestions for product improvements.</li> <li>Adapting & iterate: Things will change rapidly and often - you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and change and help support what comes next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience in Small Business sales, ideally selling business solutions or financial services; knowing how to engage business customers and understand their mindset, needs and pain points.</li> <li>Have a proven track record of meeting (or exceeding) sales quotas / targets in a performance-driven environment.</li> <li>Are an expert at managing a full sales cycle: from prospecting to activation, including structured and rigorous outreach and follow-ups and cross-team coordination.</li> <li>Have high emotional intelligence and are able to quickly connect and build a relationship with customers of diverse backgrounds and levels of knowledge.</li> <li>Are a strategic communicator,  excellent at building trust and helping customers discover value - you’re consultative, you listen, you ask insightful questions.</li> <li>Are adaptable and resilient, you embrace change and have a strong winning mindset to see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.</li> <li>Can communicate clearly: written, verbal, via video; You thrive when things aren’t fully defined yet.</li> <li>Can demonstrate high levels of personal organisation: tracking your pipeline, managing your time, prioritising your leads and follow-up tasks.</li> <li>Have integrity and strong consumer duty awareness: regulatory compliance, knowing your customer, reducing risk, safeguarding data and ensuring we put consumer duty first are foundational to this role and our culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking)</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Familiarity with SMBs in specific verticals (e.g. food & drink, professional services, construction)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍 4 days a week in our London office but with occasional flexibility to work remotely (in the UK)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. title: Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
description: Are you fascinated by performance marketing and can't wait to open your laptop in the morning to see how your latest ad campaign is performing? From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth. Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting. REPLUG is looking for an experienced Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) , eager to take the next steps in their mobile marketing career working in a fast-growing international agency. Taking care of MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) setup to ensure proper monitoring by our Mobile Paid User Acquisition team Creation and updating of performance reports based on targeted KPIs on tools such as Google Sheet, Google Data Studio, Tableau, etc. Continuous analysis and optimization of user acquisition and retargeting campaigns to achieve our clients' business goals.
