title: Senior Fraud Investigator, Prevent
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍</strong>UK Remote | 💰£31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>✨</p> <p><strong>Shift pattern: 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm, working 1 in 5 weekends and 1 week of 11:30am - 8pm every 4 weeks. </strong><strong><em>Please note you may be required to work bank holidays, including Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Years Day.</em></strong></p> <p>Start date - <strong>Monday <strong>18th</strong> Jan 2027</strong></p> <p><strong>⭐ About our Financial Crime & Fraud Team:</strong></p> <p>Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Senior Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Fraud Investigator, you will be part of the Prevent pillar which provides vital intervention and education to Monzo customers who are experiencing potential active fraud attempts on their funds across two main channels:</p> <ul> <li>Authorised card payment fraud</li> <li>Authorised faster payment fraud</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day to day; </strong></p> <p>Senior Fraud Investigators in our Prevent pillar support the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar by answering escalations, supporting operational changes, and speaking to our customers who are at potential risk of the most complex scams. We’re looking for investigators with in-depth knowledge of cryptocurrency and understanding of how this can be used by fraudsters across a range of typologies as we continue to develop and optimise our controls. This means you can complete a complex investigation from start to finish for our customers and provide clear feedback to our teams as we work together to become the most trusted bank in the UK. </p> <p>Specific responsibilities include: </p> <ul> <li>Gathering evidence from flagged transaction data </li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to investigate the nature of suspicious transactions with empathy and attention to detail.</li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to reassure and support customers through the process of identifying active fraud.</li> <li>Independently making decisions on cases and releasing or blocking flagged transactions up to a case value of £59,999.00.</li> <li>Submitting accounts for closure where first party concerns are held following investigation (in line with relevant guidance).</li> <li>Triaging cases with a value of more than £59,999.00 for upwards escalation</li> <li>Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account.</li> <li>Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future.</li> <li>Handling non-FOS complaints and feeding back to Investigators and their managers where required as part of our continuous improvement feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong understanding of regulatory requirements in fraud and/or financial crime</li> <li>A strong knowledge of cryptocurrency and how this is used in fraud typologies </li> <li>Excellent English written & verbal communication skills and experience speaking to victims of potential fraud</li> <li>Ability to be persuasive and empathetic</li> <li>Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making</li> <li>Ability to work well independently & be collaborative with the wider team</li> <li>Ability to work to deadlines</li> <li>Values driven approach in line with Monzo’s core values</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £31,100 - £39,350 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The Interview Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)</li> <li>A short call with a Recruiter</li> <li>A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Fraud Team.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>Linkedin Tags:  #LI-REMOTE #LI-SK2</p> <section class=""></section> <div id="ember214" class="ember-view messaging-side-panel__overlay"></div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director of Enterprise AI and Data Strategy
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.</p> <p>Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.</p> <p> </p> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.</li> <li>Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.</li> <li>Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.</li> <li>Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.</li> <li>You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.</li> <li>Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.</li> <li>Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.</li> <li>Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.</li> <li>Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.</li> <li>Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.</li> <li>Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.</li> <li>Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/</li> <li>Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <ul> <li data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), and AI/NVIDIA ecosystems.</li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="3,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Data/AI Production Experience (70/30 delivery costs, governance, and technical risks (not just drawing architecture diagrams).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="3,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Complex Deal Structuring:</strong> Proven history of shaping and selling large-scale Data & AI deals, specifically transitioning clients to outcome-linked or fixed-price commercial models.</p> </li> <li> <p driving margins, utilization, bench management, and capacity planning.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,0,0"><strong Comfort challenging client assumptions and negotiating ROI and business cases at the executive level.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Navigating Ambiguity:</strong> High resilience and drive. The ability to build momentum and define strategy while internal delivery models, pricing structures, and competency frameworks are still maturing.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Consultative Facilitation:</strong> Adept at framing business-outcome hypotheses, leading strategic client workshops, and breaking down massive transformations into thin, fast-value delivery slices.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Matrix Leadership & Change Management:</strong> Experience leading, scaling, and managing a matrixed team of 50–75 practitioners across the UKI region.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Coaching & Capability Building:</strong> A strong mentoring mindset focused on reskilling existing talent, raising the overall AI fluency of the practice, and shifting the team towards AI-first delivery pods.</p> </li> </ul> <br> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3 style="padding-left: 40px;">Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description: We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you. WHY DISTANCE? At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. title: Head of Applied AI
description: Head of Applied AI Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days. Defence/SC Clearance Requirements: SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential. About Cloudscaler Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards. We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that. About the role Cloudscaler's Applied AI business unit launched at the start of 2026 and has grown quickly, with an established offering, live client engagements and a pipeline in place. The current Head of Applied AI is stepping back from the role for personal reasons and remains with the business to hand over, so the incoming Head inherits a running unit rather than a standing start. We are recruiting to take it into its next phase of growth. The work is running; the structure is not yet. Offerings are defined, collateral exists, engagements are live and Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI is established. What does not yet exist is the shape around it: there is no ring-fenced team, no separate P&L and no formally defined roles. The unit began with strategy, technical expertise and sales all held in one place. Technical capability has grown since; strategy and commercial ownership have not. Formalising the practice - defining the team, the roles and the commercial structure - is part of the job rather than something the incoming Head inherits finished. This role has both external and internal responsibilities: Externally, it owns our AI go-to-market offerings and the customer, partner and pre-sales activity that turns them into pipeline, and it is Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI. Internally, it carries full commercial accountability for the business unit, provides technical delivery oversight, builds and leads the practice, and is accountable for enabling the whole company to work with AI. The role reports to the CTO and works closely with leadership across the business. The person needs to be technical enough to direct and challenge the engineering work, and commercially credible enough to scale the unit and its offering. It is a hands-on role. In one week, you might write a business case for the Leadership Team, advise a client CTO on their AI strategy, review an engineer's architecture decision and speak at a conference on what we have learned. External responsibilities These responsibilities are customer-facing, partner-facing and public facing: Relentless client focus - Maintaining a relentless client focus, calibrated to how mature the business unit is, and being decisive about where to concentrate effort and what to stop. Early on that means client meetings and pipeline growth; later it means shifting weight to larger, more sustainable areas of demand. AI go-to-market offerings - Defining and owning our AI go-to-market offerings, working with sales to take them to market. For each offering, defining what it is, who buys it, the problem it solves, its indicative price and its delivery model, and reviewing the set as the market moves, retiring what no longer sells and evolving what does. Customer relationships - Building trusted-advisor relationships with our customers, from CTOs and CDOs to engineering leaders, advising at every level and translating the same insight into the right language for a C-suite sponsor setting strategy and for the developers implementing it. Converting those relationships into repeat work and referenceable engagements. Pre-sales leadership - Leading pre-sales activity on AI opportunities, from qualification through to proposal. Supporting the delivery and commercial teams on proposals, workshops and pitches, and leading on bids where applied AI credibility is the differentiator. Qualifying opportunities in or out, including declining those we should not pursue. Client collateral - Developing reusable client collateral (opportunity assessments, roadmaps and business cases) grounded in real delivery experience. Keeping it current as the offerings and the technology move and making it available to the delivery and commercial teams rather than rebuilt for each deal. Partner and industry relationships - Building and owning our AI partner and industry relationships (AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI and relevant industry bodies), including the technical relationship, joint go-to-market activity, and achieving and maintaining the respective AI partner competencies that matter to our customers. An existing network inside our partners is a significant advantage, as is fluency in how each organisation works, where it sits in the market and what it is seeking to achieve commercially. Deciding which competencies to pursue and in what order and keeping them current. Thought leadership and public voice - Providing thought leadership on applied AI and establishing Cloudscaler's public voice through speaking, meetups, blogs and whitepapers. Building our standing in external applied AI communities and contributing to industry discussion, with material grounded in work we have delivered. Market awareness - Tracking the AI market as it moves - model releases, tooling and emerging frameworks - and forming a clear view on what is credible, what is hype, and what Cloudscaler should adopt. Bringing that view to the Leadership Team early enough to act on it, and setting our position on what we adopt, what we monitor and what we set aside. Internal responsibilities These responsibilities cover the commercial, delivery and capability side of the business unit. Commercial accountability - Carrying full commercial accountability for the business unit, which is run as its own business and measured on clear financial metrics: pipeline, revenue and gross profit. In the first six months that means a six-month revenue plan, with forecast gross profit covering the cost of the leader within six months and the team gross profit positive within two quarters. This grows into full P&L ownership as the unit scales, including team economics that stand on their own. Reporting and investment cases - Reporting to the Leadership Team on monthly KPIs covering pipeline, utilisation and gross profit against the six-month plan, and building the investment cases that fund the unit's growth. Reporting runs from month one, including the business case for establishing a dedicated team. Technical delivery oversight - Providing technical delivery oversight of AI customer engagements, working with our delivery teams. This is an architect's role rather than an engineer's: technical enough to hold your own with client engineers and to delegate the detail, and disciplined enough not to commit to capabilities we cannot feasibly deliver. Reviewing architecture and design decisions and acting as the decision-maker when a technical call is needed. Building and leading the practice - Building and leading our AI practice: owning Cloudscaler's AI strategy and the roadmap to deliver it, hiring and line-managing the team as it grows, capability development, and a repeatable methodology and delivery standards that make quality consistent regardless of who is leading the engagement. Defining the capability model and establishing the practice as an internal centre of excellence for review and quality assurance as it grows. Decomposing and delegating ownership - Breaking broad areas of activity into distinct responsibilities that can be delegated and genuinely owned, and building the team to hold them. The scope of this role is deliberately broader than one person can carry: the expectation is that the Head of Applied AI grows a team around them - including the AI enablement hires already in train - and leads through that team rather than delivering everything personally. Internal AI usage guidance, reviewing internal projects, pre-sales attendance, marketing campaigns and enablement workshops each need a named owner; an informal approach works while the unit is small but will not scale. Accelerators and intellectual property - Building reusable AI accelerators and intellectual property that shorten and de-risk customer delivery. Registering the assets as the work matures - accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures - and working with engineering to keep them testable and current as models and tooling evolve. Treating them as Cloudscaler intellectual property with standalone value rather than delivery tools alone. Company-wide AI enablement - Enabling every Cloudscaler employee to work with AI, including defining our internal AI learning pathways. Setting the guidance for how AI is used in our own work and running the enablement activity that puts it into everyday use across the whole company rather than the practice alone. Internal community of practice - Growing an internal AI community of practice, giving colleagues outside the team a route to learn and contribute. Running it as a standing forum rather than ad-hoc sessions, so that colleagues outside the practice can build AI capability alongside their own work. Candidate profile This is a senior role combining technical depth with commercial ownership. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following: Technical depth in applied AI - Current, hands-on understanding of AI technologies, models and tooling, sufficient to direct development work, review architecture and design decisions, and hold credible technical conversations with client engineers and architects. Commercial track record - Experience owning a revenue or gross profit target, building the pipeline behind it, and reporting against a plan. Comfortable being measured on financial outcomes rather than activity. Consulting and client credibility - A strong communicator who can advise at C-suite level and at engineering level, and whom clients want in the room on their most significant decisions. Practice or capability building - Experience building a team or capability from a small base: hiring, setting delivery standards, and creating repeatable methodology rather than relying on individual heroics. Partner ecosystem experience - Familiarity with the AWS and Anthropic ecosystems, or a comparable hyperscaler and model-vendor landscape, including how partner competencies and joint go-to-market activity work in practice. External profile - A track record of public contribution on applied AI, or the clear appetite and ability to build one. Leadership and delegation - Experience leading and line-managing a technical team, including setting direction, delegating genuine ownership and developing people. Comfortable achieving outcomes through a team rather than personally delivering the work. Judgement and prioritisation - The ability to decide where to concentrate a small team's effort, and the discipline to stop work that is not producing. description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Role There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it. A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love. As a Graduate Product Designer, you'll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. You'll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. You'll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship. You'll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end. You'll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders. You'll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human. You'll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won't just shape your own projects - it'll shape how design is practiced across the team. You'll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration. You'll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation. What You'll Need to Thrive We're looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role: You're in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027. You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving. AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience. You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly. You're excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. You'll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers, technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly shape the value customers get from Perk. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships. Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with. You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences. This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should work as we scale. What You’ll Do Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI. Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences. Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations. Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering. Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value. Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals. Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers. Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows. What We’re Looking For Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology. Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes. Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer. Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience. Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders. Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority. Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook. Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes. Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub. Nice to Have Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems. Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms. Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models. Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK. Additional European languages. What We Offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support The Process Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern. Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Group Financial Controller
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Group Financial Controller</strong>.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has a deep passion for systems accounting, a track record of preparing finance functions for public markets and an innovative mindset that leverages technology and AI to build efficient and robust accounting workflows.<br>The Accounting team ensures the integrity of our financial information and serves as the primary stewards of the business’ financial health. They design and operate a governance framework underpinned by robust policies, controls and systems to provide oversight and challenge to the business. The team is responsible for timely and accurate reporting and exercises judgment when necessary based on a commitment to conservative and accurate reporting, a deep understanding of accounting principles and insights into our business.</p> <p>We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader who has a deep sense of right and wrong, high integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility, understanding that the accuracy of their work is critical to the entire Company. </p> <p>You are a methodical, detail-oriented, and process-driven problem-solver who enjoys investigating discrepancies to find their root cause. You are resilient under pressure, particularly during month-end and year-end closes, and motivated by the goal of achieving a perfect, timely, and reliable result.</p> <p>Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and some data analytics, AI and ideally software engineering experience.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Chief Financial Officer.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensuring strong understanding of the risks associated with our processes and systems and leading the development and implementation of controls to mitigate those risks</li> <li>Leading the development and identification of areas of improvement of Canonical’s policies and procedures that will enable the business to scale efficiently</li> <li>Driving the implementation of the Canonical’s policies and procedures and the monitoring of compliance </li> <li>Supporting multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Managing reviews of weekly, month-end, year-end processes from balance sheet reconciliations to management accounts and statutory accounts preparation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information</li> <li>Ensuring accuracy and completeness of the recording and reporting of financial data and transactions to ensure that the Company maintains robust accounting records</li> <li>Upholding the Company’s accounting and approval processes and controls across the organization</li> <li>Managing external audits </li> <li>Developing a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions in which Canonical operates and lead the assurance of Canonical’s compliance with such regulatory requirements</li> <li>Driving projects associated with upgrading or implementing new finance systems and sensible AI adoption in the team</li> <li>Developing professional relationships and manage communications with both internal and external stakeholders - customers, vendors, tax authorities and external advisers -  including resolving questions and issues confidentially and  in a timely manner</li> <li>Managing or mentoring junior accounting staff, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A strong academic background and professional qualification in Accounting or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)</li> <li>Extensive practical IFRS knowledge and experience</li> <li>Advanced Excel skills and strong data analysis capabilities</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced setting</li> <li>Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with colleagues, management, customers, and external stakeholders</li> <li>A proactive, analytical mindset with a genuine passion for finance and a drive for continuous improvement, process efficiency and professional development</li> <li>Proven experience using enterprise-level accounting or ERP systems</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with NetSuite</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Experience with a Big 4 Accounting Firm, or a Public company</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>
